text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer multi-paragraph argument with clear intro and conclusion","quality":"overall organization","description":"It presents a more controlled essay structure with an opening claim, body support, and a closing restatement."},{"evidence":"\"Another reason why...\" \"One other major reason...\"","quality":"idea development","description":"It develops the argument through multiple distinct reasons rather than mostly repeating the same point."},{"evidence":"\"focus on there academics,\" \"save up for a higher education,\" \"work expires\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"It includes more specific examples and consequences to support its main claim."},{"evidence":"\"Another reason why students should not be allowed...\"","quality":"cohesive transitions","description":"It uses connective phrases to move from one reason to the next more explicitly."},{"evidence":"\"stressful trying to put a 4 year education in 3 years\"","quality":"academic focus","description":"It sustains a more formal, school-argument style appropriate to persuasive writing."}]}
